title: How Path Integral Diffusion Decides a Finite Spin Glass
abstract: arXiv:2611.11826v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When an AI diffusion-type generator samples a frustrated spin glass, which macroscopic alternatives does it decide first, and when? We study this for bridge-diffusion models of the Path Integral Diffusion (PID) type started from a point source. We show that every isotropic PID is a time-changed Gaussian stochastic localization, and conversely every signal-to-noise schedule is realized by a PID protocol. What a continuous-time generator decides therefore does not depend on the protocol, which only sets when and at what cost. We describe the generator's state by its partial commitments: the probabilities it assigns, at each moment, to nested classes of configurations fixed by the target. The partial commitments are martingales that move only along class contrasts. Their ensemble average gives the information about each level at an exact rate set by squared magnetization contrasts. In the balanced, effectively binary approximation

translated_title: 路径积分扩散如何决定一个有限自旋玻璃
translated_abstract: 当AI扩散型生成器对一个受阻挫的自旋玻璃进行采样时，它会首先决定哪些宏观备选方案，以及何时做出决定？我们针对从点源出发的路径积分扩散（PID）型桥扩散模型研究这一问题。我们证明，每个各向同性的PID都是经过时间变换的高斯随机局部化，反之，每个信噪比调度也都由某个PID协议实现。因此，连续时间生成器所决定的内容并不依赖于协议，协议只决定何时决定以及以何种代价决定。我们通过生成器的“部分承诺”来描述其状态：即它在每一时刻分配给由目标所确定的嵌套构型类别的概率。这些部分承诺是鞅，仅沿类别对比移动。它们的系综平均以由磁化强度对比平方精确设定的速率给出关于每个层级的信息。在平衡的、实质上二值的近似中
tldr: 该论文证明各向同性路径积分扩散等价于经过时间变换的高斯随机局部化，从而表明扩散生成器对自旋玻璃所做决策的内容与具体协议无关，并可由作为鞅的“部分承诺”按磁化对比平方设定的速率逐级刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that every isotropic Path Integral Diffusion is a time-changed Gaussian stochastic localization, showing that what a diffusion generator decides about a spin glass is protocol-independent and can be characterized level by level through martingale "partial commitments" at a rate set by squared magnetization contrasts.
